items.name: T_PineClumpCards
items.algorithm: 8-connected alpha>40 islands of the two real needle sprigs (fixed bboxes, size-checked), 2px dilation; seeded (20261018) compositing of 24-28 scaled/rotated sprigs per 1024 cell, DirectX normal XY rotated with each sprig, alpha-over, 32px alpha fade at every cell border, nearest-colour padding where alpha<0.02

items.name: T_TrunkBaseLitter
items.algorithm: Full 1.5 m forest_leaves_04 tile Lanczos 2048->1024; alpha = radial falloff (0.92 radius, 0.30 soft band) perturbed by seeded gaussian noise, modulated by displacement so raised needles/cones survive the edge; zero outside unit circle

items.name: T_LiveOakTwigCards
items.algorithm: 9 real LeafSet024 islands (opacity>0.5, 3px dilation); per-leaf darken/desaturate to olive (upper) or pale (18% undersides), roughness remap 0.55r+0.12 upper / +0.35 under, cupped-leaf dome normal from blurred distance field; seeded alternate placement along a main twig + 7-9 short side twigs (8 radial for C) drawn with tree_bark_03 colour until coverage>=0.42 (0.46 for D) before the border fade; 32px cell-border alpha fade; nearest-colour padding

items.name: T_ImpostorConiferSapling
items.species: young Monterey pine / Douglas-fir proxy, 2.0 m
items.direction_from_frame: g=2*(col+0.5)/4-1, h=2*(row+0.5)/4-1; a=(g+h)/2, b=(g-h)/2; dir_to_camera=normalize(a, b, 1-|a|-|b|) in X,Y,Z-up (row 0 = top of atlas)
items.normal_encoding: world-space unit normal *0.5+0.5, X/Y/Z-up (linear, not tangent space)
items.card_sources: Derived/T_PineClumpCards_* or Derived/T_LiveOakTwigCards_* (cells resampled to 256 px)
